priorPin: Pacta's aave-v3-gho governance record is pinned at Ethereum 26402160. In a separate observation of the Core Pool, supply caps at 26402160 and 26407946 match the old values below. At 26407947, PoolConfigurator emitted five SupplyCapChanged events in tx 0x67fb17b442a0821cfcf0c3a647e5f0ff86d62d42ecfc6e29da75a4543209c256: cbBTC 20,000 to 22,500; weETH 1,500,000 to 1,420,000; WBTC 38,200 to 35,500; BTC.b 225 to 40; eBTC 134 to 100 (whole tokens). WBTC subsequently moved to 36,000 at 26445177, tx 0x96d819926030f6e322194c09069e38fe45c9b6f9785f8fad0735d9a891896067, log 347. All five final caps are verified from the Core Pool at 26449179. getConfiguration returns a packed word: (word >> 116) & 68719476735 is the supply cap. The submitted cbBTC read decodes to 22,500.
